about: Hybrid logical clocks (spec/sync-protocol.md, HLC). compare: by physical time (ms), then counter, then device, which only breaks exact ties; devices compare by their characters' codes, as plain ASCII strings; expected is -1 when a is older, 1 when newer, 0 when the same. tick: the clock of a local edit, from the device's last clock and its corrected now; counter is a uint32, so at 4294967295 the clock moves to the next millisecond. receive: the device's last clock after it takes a change, so its next edit orders after the change. offset: what a device adds to its own time to correct it, from when it sent Hello (sentMs), when Welcome arrived (receivedMs) and Welcome's server_ms: serverMs - (sentMs + receivedMs) / 2, divided as whole numbers. ahead: whether a clock runs further past the server's now than syncLimits.clockAheadMs (design/src/limits.ts) allows, so the server refuses its frame; its ms is now + clockAheadMs + pastLimitMs, so the cases hold whatever the limit.

compare.name: the counter breaks a tie in time
the device breaks an exact tie
devices compare by their characters' codes

tick.name: time moved on: now, counter back to 0
the same millisecond: the counter moves
now behind the last clock: the last clock, counter moved
a full counter rolls into the next millisecond

receive.name: a newer change carries the clock forward
the same millisecond with a larger counter
an older change leaves the clock

offset.name: the device is behind the server
the device is ahead of the server
an odd round trip divides as whole numbers

ahead.name: exactly as far ahead as allowed
